notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/kadhyo__wheeledrobotsimulations --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and neither the hardware nor the sim backend was run. The upstream is a legacy gym environment (nav_env.py:6) whose constructor calls pyfastsim (nav_env.py:14,75); gym and pyfastsim are not installed where the gate runs, package code never imports the clone, and the fake is this package's pure Python kinematic stand-in for SimpleNavEnv, never compared with the upstream environment. The package serves kitchen-v1 only: kitchen-v0 registers assets/kitchen.xml whose map cuisine.pbm is absent from the clone, while kitchen-v1 uses assets/kitchen_lasers.xml and the existing kitchen.pbm. NOT COVERED: libfastsim raycast lasers (the fake returns the full ten-reading length but the values are placeholders), robot.move dynamics, wall contacts, sensor geometry, wheel slip and noise, rendering (cap.world.render.v1 stays unbound) and the README info fields pose/acceleration/velocity/time. The upstream observation space declares n_lasers+2+n_lightsensors = 12 bounds while get_all_sensors returns only the 10 laser readings (nav_env.py:118-119,182-184); the fake mirrors that mismatch and the fidelity gaps name it. Fidelity is F0 (kinematic/analytic), engine libfastsim:kitchen-v1, timestep_ms 0 because the clone states no integration interval for robot.move (one tick is one robot.move call), realtime_factor 0, clock lockstep, reset full, snapshot_restore false. Expected warnings are left: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.values and the two seeds. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was reported, and every Fact cites a text line of the clone. Only the catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used; there are no extension ids, no catalogue requests, no operator-required limit and no site-limits overlay. The device is a simulated R0 world with no hardware backend and no physical effect; the e-stop is the runtime's software latch, and the action bound is the environment Box the Gymnasium bridge derives from the fake. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not a hand-edited package file.
